svg.title: Log and secure evidence — activity diagram
svg.desc: Activity flow for EvidenceManager logAndSecureEvidence: validates session, opens file O_RDONLY, maps to RAM via mmap OS layer, inserts to DB via IPC, creates C++ entity and notifies observers.

g.onclick: sendPrompt('Why does JusticeFlow open evidence files as read-only?')
sendPrompt('How does mapFileToMemory work with mmap in EvidenceManager.cpp?')
g.text: Map file to RAM via mmap()

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What SQL INSERT is generated for the evidence table?')
sendPrompt('What is the role of IPC manager in JusticeFlow?')
sendPrompt('What fields does the Evidence C++ entity hold in JusticeFlow?')
sendPrompt('What does notifyObservers trigger in JusticeFlow evidence logging?')
